pt-BR.closedBody: 148 issues fechadas nos últimos 90 dias, com tempo médio de resolução de 2,4 dias.

en-US.accountDesc: Make changes to your profile here. Click save when you're done.
en-US.name: Name
en-US.passwordDesc: Change your password here. After saving, you'll be signed out of other sessions.
en-US.overviewBody: Revenue of $45,231.89 this month, up 20.1% from last month, with 2,350 new subscriptions.

en-US.openBody: 12 open issues, 3 of them flagged as blockers for the next release.
en-US.closedBody: 148 issues closed in the last 90 days, with an average resolution time of 2.4 days.
